stem: The solution to the equation \(7x - 3 = 4x + c\), where \(c\) is a constant, is 2 more than the solution to the equation \(2x + 5 = 17\). What is the value of \(c\)?
solution: Solve \(2x + 5 = 17\): \(x = 6\). So the first equation has the solution \(x = 8\).
verify:
x, c = symbols('x c')
x0 = solve(Eq(2*x + 5, 17), x)[0]
cs = solve(Eq(7*(x0 + 2) - 3, 4*(x0 + 2) + c), c)
assert cs == [21]
assert solve(Eq(7*x - 3, 4*x + 21), x) == [x0 + 2]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == cs[0] and len(spr_answers) == 1
